name: Area Converter
description: Convert area between square millimeters, square meters, hectares, square kilometers, square feet, acres, square miles, and more instantly.

faq.question: How big is a hectare or an acre, intuitively?
faq.answer: A hectare (10,000 m²) is roughly the size of a large sports stadium including its grounds — about 2.47 acres. An acre (4,046.86 m²) is close to the size of a standard American football field including both end zones.

faq.question: How accurate are these conversions?
faq.answer: Every unit is defined by its exact factor in square meters, derived from the exact length definitions (e.g. 1 acre = 4,840 square yards exactly), so results are as accurate as floating-point arithmetic allows.
